svg.title: Transgender medicine pathway: assess whether a young person has gender dysphoria, then climb the reversibility ladder from fully reversible puberty blockers at Tanner 2, to partially reversible masculinizing testosterone or feminizing estrogen with anti-androgen after the WPATH criteria are met, to irreversible surgery after mental health referral, each with its regimen, effects, risks and monitoring
